blocks.text: During the first edition of the Negros Trade Fair 40 years ago, 30 vendors from Negros Occidental gathered at the Makati Carpak to showcase local crafts, products, and wares from the region. Following the collapse of the sugar industry, sugar farm workers began to harness their creativity through food, weaves, furniture, and the arts, as a means for augmenting their livelihoods. And it was at the first Negros Trade Fair where they began to see the rays of a new sunrise for the region.
